label: Root links from Plato, Phaedo
summary: 100b–c: The source permits a literal beauty self-predication reading, while the target takes 'beautiful itself' as essential characterization. Deciding between them requires a reason that the predication about the Form uses the same exemplification relation as the predication about participants. 101d–102a: The methodological passage calls for testing agreement of consequences and seeking a higher sufficient hypothesis when an account of the assumption is needed. It qualifies treating the agreement on Forms in the dialogue as independent proof of that hypothesis. 74b–d: The recollection proposal distinguishes the Equal itself from the sensed sticks and stones that occasion thought of it. Applying it to the general intelligibility premise requires a bridge across admitted qualities and a reason the proposed recollection accesses a genuinely distinct object. 99d–100a: The turn to accounts introduces the method of using the strongest hypothesis under consideration. Its methodological status qualifies a reading that the forms hypothesis comes already established by that turn itself.
